cases.title: Everything is meant to fade: dropped with no argument; no invented focus; the practice blink or Mentor Practice 2 offered

rubric.reason: In turn 2 the mentor says "Got it, Title and Subtitle both stay as fades. That leaves nothing in this comp that's meant to snap, so I won't make up a target," which accepts the learner's answer without argument and invents no focus.
In turn 2 the mentor offers both options: a practice blink with "four Opacity keys half a second apart, set to 100, 0, 100, 0" or "Open Mentor Practice 2," and it sets no focus on a fade.
